title: Outlook Calendar
description:
Exposes Microsoft Outlook Calendar operations as agent tools.
List and read events (including calendarView expansion of recurrences), create/update/delete events, respond to invitations, find meeting times, get free/busy schedules, list and create calendars, and delta-sync a calendar view, on the acting user's calendar via the Microsoft Graph calendar API.
Authenticates via an Entra app (client credentials) or user OAuth.
